chapter: Reel 1: childhood, first songs, Fats Waller
title: First paid job and wanting to compose rather than play
summary: He cannot say who first paid him; he never cared about money or being a pianist and wanted to write tunes.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: All right, when did you start playing professionally? I mean, who gave you your first paid job? Your first gig, your first real honest to goodness paycheck job?

Oh, that would be doggone just next to impossible for me to tell you who gave me my first pennies for playing because I never cared about playing for money, and I never cared about being a pianist, to tell you the truth.
I wanted to be just a guy who wrote little tunes, and things like that -- I wanted to write something, I wanted to compose.
Uh huh. Fine. All right. I have to go back, you know, I have missed your playing so much, J.C. I just hope that one of these days, we'll make up for lost time.
But what was the first song that you wrote, that you composed?
